capabilities: Add editable labels to Canvas cards
Display text cards as sticky notes
Switch card and group appearance across an entire Canvas
Set default appearances for newly created cards and groups
extras: Not yet available in the official Obsidian Community Plugins directory; manual installation via downloaded release files is required.
intentEvidence: Canvas Toolkit adds practical customization tools to Obsidian Canvas.
problem: Obsidian Canvas offers limited appearance options for cards and groups, so users cannot label cards or restyle many nodes at once.
summary: Canvas customization plugin that adds editable labels, sticky-note text cards, board-style groups, and bulk appearance controls to Obsidian Canvas.
